l1j_pc_to_normal_npc_damage.scope: Candidate for a player-backed mage versus ordinary living monster. Companion PC_NPC versus NPC_NPC runtime direction is UNKNOWN; visual NPC-like actor does not decide it.
l1j_pc_to_normal_npc_damage.integer_semantics: Java int narrowing truncates toward zero at EACH compound assignment. Integer / divides toward zero BEFORE Math.floor; preserve order, including negative MR-hit intermediate values.
steps: damage=sum(N independent uniform integers U{1..D})+V. This sum is not uniformly distributed over its min/max total.
PC caster only: add equipped weapon.getMagicDmgModifier(), or0 if no weapon.
attrDefense=sign(resist)*trunc(0.32*abs(resist))/32.0 for target PC Earth/Fire/Water/Wind resistance; NPC target attrDefense=0 in this L1J method. Ray16 has no element-resistance accessor.
PC_NPC only: if attr!=None and weakAttr==attr, damage=trunc(damage*1.2).
PC caster only: if skill_level<=6, independent roll U{1..100}; if roll<=10+originalMagicCritical, damage=trunc(damage*1.5).
PC caster only: add originalMagicDamage, then add10 if ILLUSION_AVATAR active.

damage=truncDiv(damage*leverage,10); neutral/reference leverage10. Pet/summon targets outside war have /8 branch, outside ordinary monster scope. Target immunity/missing-effect guards can zero damage.

PC caster MR: q=truncDiv(MR-originalMagicHit,2) if MR<=100 else truncDiv(MR-originalMagicHit,10). coefficient=1-0.01*q if MR<=100 else0.6-0.01*q. damage=trunc(damage*coefficient). MR100 takes first branch; MR101 second. No extra max0 clamp is added by calcMrDefense.
l1j_pc_to_normal_npc_damage.npc_caster_difference: NPC caster has no PC weapon/original/critical/weakness branch; it uses INT+extraSP. NPC caster MR performs independent U{1..100}: if MR>=roll, damage integer-divides by2. Do not silently choose NPC_NPC for companion.

l1j_healing.scope: Living non-undead admitted target; same current caster INT/magicBonus and lawful required. Existing heal0 context producer gap remains separate.
l1j_healing.integer_semantics: Dice are independent; Java int*=double truncates toward zero, then leverage integer division truncates toward zero.
steps: magicBonus=lookup caster INT in L1Character.magicBonus for INT<=50; INT>50 uses INT-25. healingBonus=min(10,magicBonus); no added max0 clamp.
N=skills.damage_value+healingBonus; heal=sum(N independent U{1..skills.damage_dice}). If N<=0 loop rolls zero dice. skills.damage_dice_count is NOT used by calcHealing.
alignmentRevision=1.0; if lawful>0, add lawful/32768.0. heal=trunc(heal*alignmentRevision).
heal=truncDiv(heal*leverage,10), neutral/reference leverage10. calcHealing has NO SP term, MR term or critical roll.

L1SkillUse starts dmg=-heal; WATER_LIFE doubles it, then POLLUTE_WATER integer-divides by2. PC_NPC undead type1 flips sign to damage; undead type3 becomes0. Companion heal must admit living target and authoritative HP writer must clamp recovery to missing HP.

l1j_status_probability_local_subset.probability: max1(L1J magicBonus(INT) + level//4 + (mage?1:-1)) dice of randint(1,per-spell probability_dice), minus target MR; compare d100. L1Character1070-1084 supplies magicLevel/bonus. Leverage10/originalMagicHit0 and absent PC MR0 are LOCAL omissions, not recovered Classic values.
l1j_status_probability_local_subset.npc_inputs: npc_status_reference exact existing l1j_npcid join; MP starts MonsterDef.mp. Earth1/Fire2/Water4/Wind8.
l1j_status_probability_local_subset.numbers: L1J mana randint5..14+INT//2; NPC weapon-break final physical damage/2; meditation+5 per regen tick. LOCAL meditation interval10s, slow interval2, berserk interval0.5/duration30s. Official durations override SQL.

cost_policy.public_mp: Per-entry mp_cost is official BASE cost, not proof of actual dynamic debit.
cost_policy.l1j_reference: L1SkillUse1028-1087 applies tier/INT reductions, specific equipped-item halves, originalMagicConsumeReduction, minimum1 for positive base MP. NPC branch uses raw SQL. A future runtime must select coherent current cost authority and commit HP/MP/materials atomically.

range_and_cooldown.range: Public N-kan target string is preserved exactly plus numeric tile candidate. Metric, map/LOS/wall/door, target relation and inclusive boundary need actual server policy. Self target has no public numeric range: null remains.
range_and_cooldown.cooldown: Official API does not publish server reuse. Fixed-client UI delay is raw metadata with UNKNOWN unit/meaning. L1J reuseDelay is ms: SkillUse1534-1535 -> SkillDelay66-69 -> GeneralThreadPool94. It remains a LOCAL candidate. Missing UI delay is not zero server cooldown.
